en-US.description:
Hello, my Hyechungs~~

I really wanted to capture some cherry blossom photos with the whole family before it rained,

so we rushed over last week!🌸

Even though we see cherry blossoms every year, I wonder how they can look so new and beautiful every year...🌸😍

It was such a beautiful day that I felt it was really worth squeezing in time just to go see them with the whole family,

and I don't know what that meant back when everyone was talking about the "terrible twos" (Naughty Fours)...

But these days, I’m experiencing it firsthand...😵‍💫

Starting with "No?", he’s become better at talking about various things,

and now he’s even started asking back questions quite a bit these days lol.

But since he’s good at talking, the moments that really annoy me are increasing just as much...😱

And the product I introduced in this video is

Samsung Electronics' [2026 Bespoke AI Ice Water Purifier] 🧊🤍

Ever since I was pregnant with Seungyu,

I kept telling Chungchung that we absolutely had to switch to an ice water purifier before summer came,

and finally~~~ we I got one for my home too! 🤩

Living in this busy modern society,

it’s surprisingly difficult to schedule a home care visit, isn’t it? 🤔

But since it provides 99.9% sterilization with its AI customized sterilization function,

it reduces the burden of maintenance and gives me more confidence! 💘

And the most amazing feature among them was Voice ID!

It was convenient enough to be able to pour water with just a word, even from a distance, but

it was truly amazing and convenient that it recognized my voice and dispensed water according to the style I had pre-set~~👏🏻👏🏻

Samsung.com is recruiting a Bespoke AI Ice Water Purifier experience group‼️ from April 13th to April 26th‼️

So, if you are a fan who wants to try it out yourself, please check the link below~🤍
